title: Text hyperlinks (URL + Target) — model, UI, FLA import, SWF HTML anchor
description: DONE. Text hyperlinks (URL + Target) full vertical slice. Model: linkUrl?/linkTarget? on TextDisplayObject + timeline updates. UI: Link URL input + Target dropdown (_self/_blank/_parent/_top) in PropertiesPanel TextView + agent registry. FLA import: the binary CPicText decoder already READ but discarded the run url + target strings (flash8-binary.ts readTextRunFields lines ~2482/2492 of flacomdoc handleText layout: String url after letterSpacing s16, String target after vertical/rtl/rotation bytes for ts>=9). Captured them into TextRun.linkUrl/linkTarget -> Fla8Text -> convertElement/convertFla8Text. NO byte-offset change (same readPlainString/readCString consume identical bytes) so zero CArchive desync risk; Magnet.fla autoKern decode test still green. SWF compile: encodeDefineEditText wraps content in <a href TARGET> and sets HTML flag bit 9 only when linkUrl non-empty; static+link routes through DefineEditText instead of glyph DefineText (in both compile.ts and sprite.ts). VERIFIED: core 5128, swf 1297, ui 632 unit tests pass; tsc clean all 3 pkgs; golden-report SELF-DETERMINISM PASS + 0 tag-count mismatches; NEW Ruffle e2e text-hyperlink.spec.ts passes 4/4 runs -- clicking the linked text in Ruffle calls window.open('http://example.com/clicked','_blank') (proven by overriding window.open and asserting the recorded call; Ruffle navigator.rs navigate_to_url -> window.open_with_url_and_target for non-empty target). This is runtime click->navigate proof, not byte-presence.
